text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Excuse me~ Trainer-kun, are you there~?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Excuse me~ Trainer-chan, are you there~?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Do you have a sewing kit? The hem on 
Grass-chan's uniform is fraying a bit.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Great, I'll go ahead and use it, then.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for the inconvenience.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright Grass-chan, hold still. I'll fix 
it up in a jiffy.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, I can do it myself, so you really 
don't have to go that far...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"It's totally fine, don't hold back! I'm 
doing this because I want to, anyway, 
right?♪"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: U-Understood. Please go ahead, then...

With a practiced hand, Maruzensky mended 
Grass Wonder's school uniform.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, looking great♪ Turned out 
beautifully~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. You're so meticulous 
and efficient... I couldn't help but be 
mesmerized.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You notice things about me that even I 
hadn't realized. You truly are amazing, 
Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Being praised that much makes me a bit 
embarrassed~. Still, I'm happy you're 
relying on me."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've been taught the basics of taking care 
of daily matters. So let me know whenever 
you're in trouble♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My mother and our housekeeper did. They've 
taught me so many things since I was 
little.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“You can't just rely on others all the 
time,” they said. Thanks to that, I was 
able to stand proudly on my own two feet♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, senpai, you live on 
your own outside the academy rather than 
in the dorms, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Your parents and teachers must really 
trust that you can take good care of 
yourself, Senpai."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Urk! R-Right... I've properly handled all 
the basics around that, too, so...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "...? Did I ask something strange?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, don't worry about it! That was 
just something on my end!"
choice_data_list: You've always been reliable, haven't you?
Isn't living on your own tough?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"That's true~. Everyone's certainly been 
telling me that since way back when."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Rather than having the maids take care of 
me, I usually just did chores together 
with them...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I used to look after the underclassmen at 
school, so I was actually pretty popular.
choice_data_list: I can picture the scene clearly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"When you were a kid, Senpai... I bet you 
were a dependable big sister just like you 
are now."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Not just underclassmen or 
classmates, but upperclassmen came to me 
for advice too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
People tell me all the time that I don't 
feel younger than them... It must be my 
mature aura shining through!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: An adult aura, is it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've always liked being relied on. 
I was totally ready for whatever came my 
way.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"No matter the favor, it's easy-peasy for 
big sis Maruzensky!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: E-Easy-peasy lemon squeezy?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, make sure you remember that too, 
Grass-chan. Fufu♪

I figured that wasn't the only reason she 
didn't seem younger, but I decided not to 
point it out...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's true that... there's a lot to 
do, and I really am quite busy, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In our case, we have schoolwork and races 
too. Balancing that with housework is 
tough.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Don't worry about it, though. I'm doing 
it because I want to, so it's not a burden 
at all.”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I'm making sure to get my daily 
rest and relaxation."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: A breather, you say?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's right. In short... a drive!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Even if things get a little unpleasant, or 
you feel like the stress is piling up—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Just take Tac-chan out for a spin, and all 
your worries will blow right away!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, going alone feels a bit lonely, so I 
usually bring someone along, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see. That is precisely when a Trainer is 
there to be relied upon... isn't that 
right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you understand so well. It makes me 
happy that we're on the same page~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you're worried about me, taking action 
is the best way to show it. So I'll be 
counting on your support from now on, too♪

It seems to be a foregone conclusion that 
Maruzensky will continue dragging me along 
on her drives...
